title: Hide Pack Forge 'Build Lane / Task Planner' Codex section from default operator-facing navigation
goal: The Pack Forge screen (screen-pack-forge) contains two panels side by side: 'Adaptive Planning' with pack management (operator-facing), and 'Build Lane / Task Planner' with a Codex task form and codex-related buttons (developer-facing internal tooling). The Codex panels (codex-task-form, prepare-codex-task-btn, codex-suggestions, codex-pack-preview, codex-context, codex-task-result) are developer build-lane infrastructure that should not be visible to operators by default. Gate these panels behind an advanced/developer mode toggle in Settings (e.g., enable_build_lane: false by default) or remove them from the Pack Forge screen and expose only via an internal-only route. The Adaptive Planning and Pack Summary panels should remain fully visible. Operators should be able to validate, approve, and deploy packs without seeing Codex internals.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: Pack Forge screen exposes the Codex build lane task planner (dom elements: codex-task-form, prepare-codex-task-btn, codex-suggestions, codex-pack-preview, codex-context, codex-task-result) as a visible panel in the main navigation. This is developer infrastructure for the AI build lane, not an operator-facing feature. Exposing it confuses operators and may expose governance details that should stay internal.
generation_reason: System review 2026-05-01: Codex build lane panels visible in Pack Forge for all operators — should be hidden by default.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only hide Codex panels. Do not remove Adaptive Planning or pack lifecycle UI. Do not break Codex functionality — just hide it.

success_criteria: By default (no developer mode setting active), Codex build lane panels are not visible in Pack Forge.
Pack validate, approve, and deploy flows still work for operators.
Codex panels remain accessible when developer/build-lane mode is enabled in Settings.
No regression in pack lifecycle tests.
must_not_touch: Pack validation, approval, or deployment logic

acceptance_criteria: Default Pack Forge view shows only Adaptive Planning, Pack Summary, and Registry panels.
Codex sections hidden unless build_lane_mode enabled.
Pack lifecycle tests pass without regression.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
